card.name: Parenthesis after Inhalational Anthrax
card.fires_on: Mostly the opening parenthesis right after the phrase "Inhalational Anthrax", just before "Post-Exposure" in dosing tables. Weaker on a few punctuation or dose-unit marks in dose and exam lists.

modes.label: Anthrax post-exposure bracket
modes.description: Opening parenthesis after the heading Inhalational Anthrax, where "Post-Exposure" comes next.

modes.label: Scattered punctuation and units
modes.description: Weaker hits on a comma in a list of findings, a closing parenthesis after a dose, or a unit after a dose number.

card.writes: Little clear effect; it suppresses the words positive and negative, so it may steer away from those after the bracket.
card.plain: It fires on the bracket that opens "(Post-Exposure)" after the anthrax heading in dosing tables.
